description: Calculate how much tax is withheld from a US bonus in 2026 and what is left: federal income tax (the 22% flat rate or the combined method, 37% above $1 million), Social Security, Medicare, and the state's own bonus withholding rule, for all 50 states and DC. Use it for 'how much of my $X bonus will I keep in <state>?'. Withholding is not the final tax: the bonus is taxed at your normal rate on your return. Use us_paycheck_take_home instead for regular pay, and salary_increase for a raise. When the bonus is paid on its own it also returns the result under the other federal method so the two can be compared.

annual_salary_usd.description: Regular yearly salary in US dollars, before the bonus. For example 75000.

bonus_paid.description: Whether the employer pays the bonus as a separate payment (the usual case) or adds it to a regular paycheck. Default separately.

bonus_usd.description: Gross bonus in US dollars. For example 5000.

earlier_supplemental_pay_usd.description: Bonuses and other supplemental pay already paid this calendar year, before this one, in US dollars. Total supplemental pay above $1 million in a year is withheld at 37%. Default 0.

federal_method.description: How the employer withholds federal income tax on a bonus paid separately: the flat 22% rate (the common choice) or the combined (aggregate) method. Ignored when the bonus is paid with a regular paycheck. Default flat_22_percent.

filing_status.description: Filing status on the federal Form W-4, step 1(c): single (or married filing separately), married (filing jointly) or head (head of household). Default single.

pay_frequency.description: How often the employee is paid: weekly (52 paychecks a year), biweekly (26), semimonthly (24, twice a month) or monthly (12). Default biweekly.

state.description: Two-letter postal code of the state where the employee works and lives: all 50 states and DC (for example CA, NY, TX, DC).

w4_step2_checkbox.description: The 'multiple jobs or spouse works' box in Form W-4 step 2(c). Default false.

name: us_bonus_tax

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.
